verification_notes: Korkmaz A1817 corresponds to the 14-piece Rosagold Elektro Set (Elektronik Çeyiz Seti).
The 14-piece bundle consists of Korkmaz Çaytema tea maker (4 pcs), Kahvekolik Turkish coffee maker (2 pcs), Mia Mega blender set (7 pcs), and Tostema Midi toaster (1 pc).
